resource: presentation events in one session's WORLD_PRESENTATION batch (state domain 19, capability 23 PRESENTATION_V1) of one sync unit
unit: events per session per sync unit
allocation_impact: Events beyond 1,024 are dropped, never queued: the server keeps the observer's own events, then the nearest by the D87 order, ties broken by decision ordinal and then emission ordinal (select_presentation_batch), so the kept set never depends on insertion order. The encoder refuses a 1,025th event as a server fault and the decoder refuses it LimitExceeded before decoding it. Non-durable; dropping events changes no outcome.
boundary_tests: max=1024: crates/protocol-oteryn/src/presentation_tests.rs a_full_batch_round_trips_within_its_bound (1,024 worst-case events encode and decode)
max+1=1025: crates/protocol-oteryn/src/presentation_tests.rs a_full_batch_round_trips_within_its_bound (a 1,025th event is refused LimitExceeded in both directions)
notes: SPELL-PRESENT-0 §9 and §13. B3 batch measurement (typical and p99 bytes for a crowded hunt, server time per sync unit) is recorded on #162 before activation. Registered by PRESENT-WIRE-1 (MAGIC-CAST-1, #1622).
